text_blocks.snippet: Common symptoms of a viral illness include fever, cough, fatigue, headache, sore throat, runny or stuffy nose, and body aches. Some viral infections may also cause nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. The duration and severity of symptoms can vary widely depending on the specific virus.
snippet_highlighted_words: fever, cough, fatigue, headache, sore throat, runny or stuffy nose, and body aches

list.snippet: Fever: A fever is often one of the first signs of a viral infection.
Cough: Respiratory viruses can cause coughing, which may be dry or produce mucus.
Fatigue: Feeling unusually tired or weak is a common symptom as the body works to fight off the virus.
Headache: Headaches are a frequent symptom in many viral illnesses, including COVID-19.
Sore Throat: Sore throat is a common symptom, especially in respiratory viral infections like the common cold.
Runny or Stuffy Nose: Nasal congestion and a runny nose are often associated with viral respiratory infections.
